ACCEPTANCE.zero_denominator_policy: rate reported as NULL / N.A. — 0 violations, never 0%

FINDING_evaluability_is_not_discriminati.statement: EVERY claim is measurable on a substantial number of opportunities; the minimum is ~19.8k evaluable pairs
FINDING_evaluability_is_not_discriminati.consequence: LOW EVALUABILITY, one of the three prespecified failure modes, does NOT discriminate within this family
FINDING_evaluability_is_not_discriminati.structure: evaluability is banded by source-feature DEPTH: the ~2,904 claims below 50k evaluable involve the deepest features (sig_buy age>=50, sig_tz_flip state-identifiability); the ~14,700 at ~359k involve depth-2 features only

DEGENERATE_CONCENTRATION_GUARD.status_of_those: top10_share_positive = 1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION — carries NO concentration information
DEGENERATE_CONCENTRATION_GUARD.WARNING: the unconditional top10_share_positive quantiles (p75 = 1.0000) are dominated by the degenerate subset and MUST NOT be read as evidence of concentration

BREAKDOWN_position_pair.observation: the three position pairs are near-identical in support; no position is structurally starved

BREAKDOWN_token_type_pair.observation: token TYPE is by far the strongest structural driver of support: median positive 5 (bool->bool) vs 372 (cat->cat), a ~74x difference, and 37.5% vs 15.1% zero-positive
BREAKDOWN_token_type_pair.interpretation_guard: this is a SUPPORT/STRUCTURAL observation only. It says nothing about which claims are informative about anything.

HOLDOUT_DIAGNOSTIC.role: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY — NOT a hard eligibility authority
HOLDOUT_DIAGNOSTIC.finding: more than half the claims (51.8%) never fire in the 12 HOLDOUT sessions, and the median claim has ZERO positive occurrences
HOLDOUT_DIAGNOSTIC.consequence: this directly vindicates excluding HOLDOUT from hard eligibility — a HOLDOUT floor would eliminate the majority of claims on 12 sessions of timing luck
HOLDOUT_DIAGNOSTIC.warning: episode/opportunity counts, NOT independent temporal replications

THREE_FAILURE_MODES_STATUS.LOW_EVALUABILITY: does NOT discriminate here (0 zero-evaluable, min 19,783)
THREE_FAILURE_MODES_STATUS.LOW_POSITIVE_SUPPORT: discriminates strongly — 9,454 claims never fire; median 65
THREE_FAILURE_MODES_STATUS.LOW_BREADTH: discriminates strongly — median 53 securities, but 12,817 claims sit at or below the 48-security degenerate threshold
